title: dep-scan mcp get_decisions output
description: The document the get_decisions tool returns: the decisions record the scan's manifest carries, every triage entry with its computed status and what it matches, and the last gate result the scan directory holds.

scanDir.description: The scan directory that was read, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

file.description: The decisions file: relative to the scan directory with / separators when a relative path exists, otherwise absolute.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of the decisions file.

selectedBy.description: What selected the file: default, option, environment, project-config or user-config.

file.description: The VEX document, recorded the way the decisions file is.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 hex digest of that document.

vex.description: Each VEX document the evaluation applied.

failOn.description: Each --fail-on expression the evaluation applied, as given.

decisions.description: The decisions record from the scan's manifest, or null when the scan had no decisions work.

index.description: The entry's 1-based position among the triage decisions.

handle.description: The entry's stable handle, which depscan triage review and remove take: tr- and the first ten hex digits of the SHA-256 of its canonical selector, with proposed_by for a proposal.

state.description: The CycloneDX impact analysis state of the entry.

status.description: live applies, a proposal waits for a person to approve it, an expired entry suppresses nothing, a stale entry matched no finding.

proposedBy.description: Who or what proposed the decision.

matches.description: The findings the entry matches in the scan.

entries.description: The triage entries of the decisions file, in file order. Empty when the scan read no decisions file.

stale.description: The entry numbers that matched no finding in the scan.

expired.description: The entry numbers past their expiry.

proposals.description: The entry numbers waiting for a person to approve them.

gate.description: The last gate result the scan directory holds, its depscan.expectations.json, or null when the scan ran no gate.

warnings.description: Why the entries are missing or may differ from what the scan applied: the decisions file the scan recorded cannot be found, its digest changed since the scan, or a file the environment or configuration names is read instead.
